summary: Frontend-only testing completed for Voiladi iOS-style restyle iteration. All pages load without console errors. Design successfully implements monochrome palette (ink #1D1D1F) with ONE deep navy accent (#2B4C7E), black hearts/buttons, flat iOS tab bar with navy active state, and white blurred banner toasts. Trivial toasts ('Code sent', 'Passed', 'You liked X's photo') correctly removed. Photo upload with server-side downscaling to 1280px verified working. All navigation, auth flow, swipe actions, filters, and keyboard controls functional.

Toast styling: white translucent banner (rgba(255,255,255,0.9)) with blur(20px) backdrop-filter confirmed (iOS-style)
Design verification: Voila button bg rgb(43,76,126) = #2B4C7E navy confirmed, active tab color rgb(43,76,126) confirmed, black hearts on like button confirmed
Bottom nav: flat iOS tab bar with icon+label, navy active state, all 4 tabs (Discover, Likes, Chats, You) functional
